title: Binary-search learning-by-teaching with AlgoBo
summary: Learners first study binary search and solve a Parsons problem, then teach an LLM-based novice to understand and implement the algorithm. TeachYou prompts why/how explanations, simulates misconceptions, and gives metacognitive feedback on teaching behaviors.

sources.title: Teach AI How to Code: Using Large Language Models as Teachable Agents for Programming Education
sources.evidence_quote: participants taught different versions of AlgoBo and TeachYou

context.learner_level: Python novices without recent binary-search mastery

assessment.summary: Teach AlgoBo binary search concepts, implementation, complexity, and applications.
student_actions: Study binary search and reorder a Parsons solution.
Explain concepts and help AlgoBo fix and test code.
Discuss applications and reflect on teaching quality.

outputs.artifact: Teaching dialogue, AlgoBo code, Parsons response, and questionnaires

student_role.description: GPT-4 powered a constrained teachable agent and metacognitive Teaching Helper.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: A 15-person formative study informed the design; a 40-person between-subjects user study compared TeachYou with a baseline.
